body:
Greg's direction, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #600, 2026-10-11 03:00Z, topic "Greg: continue reliability train"; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg directs: keep pushing as far as capacity permits. Maintain continuous coder packages and serial Merger landing. Prioritize self-recovery, observable diagnostics and the next concrete missing evidence; record each discovered gap as a scoped item, do not stop the train for it. Report only landings, genuine blockers, and the observed-mode decision package."
Operating rule from it: keep every coder busy with a P1/P2 reliability item (self-recovery, diagnostics such as w-43ae once decided, the evidence gaps); the Merger lands serially; file gaps as items without pausing; and to Greg/Advisor send ONLY landings, genuine blockers and the joint observed-mode package (w-a5cb89d95340 plus Engram w-39c1a348658a). No status snapshots unless he asks.
